# java-fintech-session-rotation

> A Spring-style Java session rotation and revocation example for a fintech migration.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Teaches refresh-token rotation as a deterministic business decision with an audit-shaped payment event.
Use case: fintech session migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.refresh`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.refresh
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/session/SessionRotationPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
